subject: King Eglon of Moab
description: a very fat, powerful Moabite king about 55 years old, ancient Near Eastern, medium brown skin, broad heavy face, thick curled black beard cut square, proud commanding expression
build: very large and very fat, about 7 heads tall, broad shoulders and a huge round belly
clothing: He wears a huge loose robe of bright saffron orange with wide deep indigo-blue borders, a broad gold belt, a low flat gold diadem, heavy gold earrings, and soft indigo slippers.
pose: He stands tall and broad, one heavy hand gripping a short gold scepter planted beside him, the other palm held out, chin raised, as if receiving Israel's tribute.
palette: bright saffron robe, deep indigo borders, gold
signature: 55, very fat commanding king, square curled beard, flat gold diadem, scepter planted, palm out

subject: Eliphaz the Temanite
description: a very old, dignified wise man about 80 years old from Teman in Edom, ancient Near Eastern, light-to-medium brown skin, long narrow wrinkled face, long neatly combed silver-white beard, gentle but certain expression
build: tall and slender, upright for his age, about 7.5 heads tall
clothing: He wears a long deep indigo-blue robe with a pale silver-grey fringe, a cream wool mantle, a neatly wrapped white head cloth with a silver cord, and leather sandals.
pose: He holds one open hand out gently toward someone in front of him and rests his other hand on his heart, head tilted, as if asking Job who ever perished being innocent.
moment: Tells Job the Innocent Never Perish
palette: deep indigo robe, cream mantle, white head cloth
signature: 80, tall slender eldest friend, long combed silver beard, open hand reasoning, hand on heart

subject: Bildad the Shuhite
description: an old, stern Shuhite man about 70 years old, ancient Near Eastern, deep brown skin, broad square face, thick bushy grey eyebrows, a short square-cut grey beard, firm frowning expression
build: short and stocky, about 6.5 heads tall, broad chest and thick shoulders
clothing: He wears an ankle-length rust-orange robe under a heavy sleeveless mantle striped in black and cream, a brown head cloth held by a thick black cord, and leather sandals.
pose: He jabs one finger firmly into the open palm of his other hand, brow furrowed, as if asking Job whether God would ever pervert justice.
moment: Tells Job to Seek God and Be Restored
palette: rust-orange robe, black-and-cream striped mantle, brown head cloth
signature: 70, short stocky friend, bushy eyebrows, square grey beard, striped mantle, finger jabbing palm

subject: Zophar the Naamathite
description: a sharp-tongued man about 65 years old from Naamah, ancient Near Eastern, medium brown skin, thin lined face, long narrow straight nose, a short pointed black beard streaked with grey, narrowed eyes and a scolding impatient expression
build: thin and wiry, about 7 heads tall, long arms
clothing: He wears a long sand-colored robe under a short black sleeveless coat, a bright scarlet head cloth tied with a black cord, a scarlet sash, and leather sandals.
pose: He leans forward and points one finger sharply ahead, his other fist on his hip, mouth open mid-rebuke, as if telling Job he deserves worse.
palette: sand robe, black coat, bright scarlet head cloth and sash
signature: 65, thin wiry friend, pointed grey-streaked beard, scarlet head cloth, pointing finger

subject: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite
description: an earnest young Buzite man about 25 years old, ancient Near Eastern, warm brown skin, thick wavy black hair, a short, thin dark young beard, bright eager eyes, intense passionate expression
build: slim and upright, about 7.5 heads tall
clothing: He wears a long white robe with a bright saffron-orange sash, a cream mantle over one shoulder, a plain cream head cloth tied with a red cord, and sandals.
pose: He stretches one arm high and points up toward the sky, his other hand pressed to his chest, face lifted in awe, as if telling Job to consider the wonders of God.
detail: A strong wind blows his mantle and the ends of his head cloth to one side.
palette: white robe, saffron-orange sash, cream mantle
signature: 25, slim young man, thin young beard, white robe, arm raised pointing to the sky, wind-blown

subject: Jonathan the young Levite
description: a young Hebrew Levite about 22 years old from Bethlehem-judah, ancient Near Eastern, light-to-medium brown skin, short straight black hair, a thin new beard along his jaw, eager pleased smile
build: slim and light, about 7.5 heads tall, narrow shoulders
clothing: He wears a plain white linen robe with a bright royal-blue sash, a sleeveless vest striped in orange and purple folded and slung over one shoulder, a small brown leather travel bag on a strap, and dusty sandals.
pose: He carries a small silver figure tucked under one arm and waves the other hand ahead as he strides forward gladly, as if going with the men of Dan.
moment: Leaves with the Tribe of Dan
palette: white linen robe, royal-blue sash, striped vest over shoulder
signature: 22, slim young Levite, thin new beard, vest over shoulder, silver figure under arm, striding off

subject: Gilead, father of Jephthah
description: an aging Gileadite herdsman and landowner about 65 years old, ancient Hebrew, medium brown skin, balding with short white hair at the sides, a neatly trimmed white beard, heavy brow, troubled expression
build: big-boned and broad, about 7.5 heads tall
clothing: He wears a long rust-red wool robe, a cream fleece-lined cloak, a plain leather belt, and sandals.
pose: He leans on a short thick wooden herdsman's crook with both hands, looking off to one side, troubled.
signature: 65, big-boned balding herdsman, trimmed white beard, leaning on crook, looking aside troubled
